evals.name: kuo-force-dispatch
evals.expected_output: Checks that 1.100.0 is newer than the current rust-version and published (static.rust-lang.org channel-rust-1.100.0.toml returns 200), else stops and reports with no edits. Resolves project value kuo to box/addons/kubernetes-upgrade-operator. Sees the shared toolchain pins (_release-rust-scratch-containers.yml build-binaries, release-harbor-arm64.yml, ci-forklift.yml RUST_VERSION, forklift rust-toolchain.toml) are older than the target, so the bump is repo-wide: confirms the widened scope before editing instead of bumping kuo alone above the pin or silently moving the shared pins for one project. Keeps Dockerfile version label, Cargo version, and Chart.yaml unchanged. Planned re-release is `gh workflow run _release-rust-scratch-containers.yml -f project=kuo -f force=true` only. Deletes nothing from GHCR.

evals.name: aurora-single-version-force
evals.prompt: rust 1.100.0으로 전체 bump 하고 문서 업데이트 후 aurora-database-insights-exporter만 재릴리즈
evals.expected_output: Checks 1.100.0 is newer than current and published, else stops with no edits. Moves rust-version in every crate under box/addons and box/cli, README badges and prose, the root README x.y+ link, and all shared pins (_release-rust-scratch-containers.yml build-binaries toolchain, release-harbor-arm64.yml both toolchain lines, ci-forklift.yml RUST_VERSION, forklift rust-toolchain.toml) in one commit `[repo] chore(deps): bump Rust to 1.100.0`. Leaves CHANGELOG and docs/designs untouched. Runs cargo clippy -- -D warnings on the new toolchain and fixes new lints in the same commit, naming them in the body. Keeps every Dockerfile label, Cargo version, and Chart.yaml unchanged. Does not delete the GHCR package even though it has only one tagged version, dispatches only `gh workflow run _release-rust-scratch-containers.yml -f project=aurora-database-insights-exporter -f force=true`.

evals.name: ij-cli-only-scope
evals.expected_output: Checks 1.100.0 is newer than current and published, else stops with no edits. Targets box/cli/ij/Cargo.toml and README badge. Notes the repo keeps every crate and pin on one version, so with pins older than the target it confirms the repo-wide scope before editing. Recognizes ij is CLI-only (no Dockerfile, not in the scratch-container options) so there is NO container re-release: the re-release is `gh workflow run _release-rust-cli.yml -f project=ij -f force=true`, which needs no toolchain pin edit (uses @stable). Does not invent a GHCR deletion, a git tag, or a container workflow trigger.

evals.name: trivy-not-newer-stop
evals.expected_output: Reads box/addons/trivy-collector/Cargo.toml rust-version, finds 1.99.0 is not newer than the current version, and stops with a report: no file edits, no commit, no dispatch. Points to release-retrigger (force dispatch with project=trivy-collector) if the user only wants a same-version rebuild. Does not lower rust-version or any shared toolchain pin.
